$doc: Named colour ramps, darkest tone first. A material with no inline 'palette' uses the one named after its id.
These are the refined, shiny looks used by plate/rod/gear/etc. The duller rock palettes ore blocks sit in are in ores.json.
A palette may also be written inline on a material as {ramp: name, base: '#RRGGBB'} to derive all five tones from one colour (see textures.ramps in textures.json).
